title: Format gate mislabeled ENGINE-gated: skipped at this sha, but fails 8/13 Source files when actually run
evidence:
local-ci.sh:70:  "ENGINE:Format (clang-format --dry-run on Source/)|scripts/format-check.sh"
docs/timings.md: 2026-08-20T18:14:53	gate 1	ENGINE:Format (clang-format --dry-run on Source/)	SKIP	0s
Executing scripts/format-check.sh directly (system clang-format 22.1.8 present, passes the script's >=14 version gate): NOT FORMATTED: Source/PacketPlumberCore/PP_Hash.h; PP_Rng.h; PP_Sim.h; PP_DeterminismTests.cpp; PP_HashTests.cpp; PP_RngTests.cpp; PPProbeCommandlet.cpp; PPProbeCommandlet.h — exit=1.
detail: format-check.sh is engine-free by design (system-clang-format fallback), but the ENGINE: label makes the runner skip it pre-engine, masking a failing check. PR body claims 'format / spine / static gates run engine-free (green)' — false for format.
recommended_fix: Drop the ENGINE: prefix from the format gate (let format-check.sh self-skip only when no clang-format exists at all); run clang-format -i over Source/ and commit the result.

title: Golden compare's engine branch is dead code — nothing ever writes .engine-probe.json
evidence:
scripts/compare-golden.sh:22-26:
# If the engine probe already produced a file (gate order: probe runs first),
# compare engine vs standalone; otherwise standalone vs the committed golden.
if [ -f docs/goldens/.engine-probe.json ]; then
  A="docs/goldens/.engine-probe.json"
local-ci.sh:75:  "ENGINE:PPProbe commandlet (headless spine probe)|scripts/run-tests-headless.sh --probe"
grep across repo: '.engine-probe' appears only in compare-golden.sh — no writer; the only --json-out call is --bless writing docs/goldens/probe-seed42-ticks100.json.
detail: Gate 7 runs the probe without --json-out, so the engine-vs-standalone comparison promised by gate 8's label ('Golden compare (PPProbe vs docs/goldens/)') never executes; only standalone-vs-committed-golden runs. Cross-runner golden equality stays unverified once the engine lands.
recommended_fix: In local-ci.sh gate 7, pass --json-out docs/goldens/.engine-probe.json so compare-golden.sh's engine branch activates when the engine is present.

title: Engine discovery triplicated with divergent env contracts — UE_ROOT honored only by local-ci.sh
evidence:
local-ci.sh:49-50:
  if [ -n "${UE_ROOT:-}" ]; then
    local cand="$UE_ROOT/Engine/Binaries/Mac/UnrealEditor-Cmd"
run-tests-headless.sh:19-23 (and install-engine.sh:10-15, identical shape):
find_engine() {
  if [ -n "${UE_EDITOR_PATH:-}" ] && [ -x "$UE_EDITOR_PATH" ]; then
    echo "$UE_EDITOR_PATH"; return 0
  fi
— no UE_ROOT handling.
detail: With UE_ROOT set, local-ci.sh marks the engine PRESENT, engine gates then invoke run-tests-headless.sh which cannot find it — exit 127 FAIL instead of SKIP, violating the runner's own 'never a silent PASS, never a false FAIL' contract; three drifting copies.
recommended_fix: Extract one shared engine-discovery helper (e.g. scripts/lib/engine.sh) sourced by local-ci.sh, run-tests-headless.sh and install-engine.sh; honor UE_EDITOR_PATH/UE_ROOT identically everywhere.

title: Pure sim core module declares unused CoreUObject/Engine dependencies
detail: The module marketed as the 'pure sim spine' links CoreUObject and Engine for nothing, inviting engine-type leakage into the module that must keep its spine headers UE-free. Technical debt against the dual-runner boundary.
recommended_fix: Reduce PublicDependencyModuleNames to Core; re-add CoreUObject/Engine only when real sim-adjacent engine types actually appear in the module.

title: Editor module declares unused dependency on the game module PacketPlumber
detail: No editor-module source includes game-module headers — PPProbe uses only PacketPlumberCore. The dependency couples editor tooling to the game shell before any real use, softening the Core/Editor/game-shell boundary.
recommended_fix: Drop "PacketPlumber" from PacketPlumberEditor.Build.cs until editor code actually includes game-module headers.
